packs.name: Velvet Hours
packs.description: Lazy major-key neo soul: ii9-V13-Imaj9 turns, back-door dominants and warm Rhodes voicings that sit behind the beat.

packs.name: Honey Planing
packs.description: Minor eleven vamps and chromatic planing for late-night neo soul grooves.

packs.name: Sunday Wood
packs.description: Slow church chords: 1-4-5 with passing diminished, IV over V slash chords and 7-3-6 walk-downs.

packs.name: Choir Loft Runs
packs.description: Uptempo gospel runs: fast 2-5-1s, shout-style turnarounds and walk-ups for praise-break energy.

packs.name: Smoke & Vinyl
packs.description: Smoky minor nines, thirteens and tritone subs for soulful boom-bap at 85 to 95 BPM.

progressions.title: Porch Light Haze
progressions.description: ii9-V13-Imaj9 in Db, then Bbm11 bends into Bb7b9 to point back at the ii. Leave it behind the kick and let it ring.

progressions.title: Late Brunch
progressions.description: Eight bars of ii-V-I, then IV to an augmented V of vi; Ab13 is the tritone sub that drops back into Gm9.

progressions.title: Corduroy
progressions.description: ii-V-I in A with a C9#11 that slides a half step down into the Bm11. Good under a swung hat.

progressions.title: Tape Warmth
progressions.description: IV-iii-vi then a ii-V that rolls back to the top. Slow strums suit a detuned Rhodes or a tape-saturated piano.

progressions.title: Slow Exhale
progressions.description: IV-iii-ii-V-I with a G7#9 secondary dominant into the ii. F13 darkens to F7b9 on the last bar to pull you round again.

progressions.title: Linen Room
progressions.description: ii-V-I in Gb that turns to the iii via F7#9. Short stabs over a held bass leave room for a vocal.

progressions.title: Sugar Water
progressions.description: ii-V-I-vi, then IV to E7#9 into Am9; Em7 to A7#5 is the secondary ii-V that sends it back to Dm9.

progressions.title: Felt Hammers
progressions.description: IV-iii-ii stepping down, with the V suspended before it resolves. Arpeggiated, it works as an intro or a hook bed.

progressions.title: Behind The Kick
progressions.description: IV-iii-vi then ii-V-I; Gmaj9 turns into G13 to lead to the IV. Push each chord an eighth early for that dragged feel.

progressions.title: Mood Lamp
progressions.description: IV to a D#7#9 that lands on the vi, then a V-of-V and V. The #9 gives the tension, the m11 releases it.

progressions.title: Second Line Velvet
progressions.description: IV to III7 to vi, a ii-V of the IV, then the borrowed minor iv into home. Bbm9-Eb13 closes the eight bars.

progressions.title: Condensation Keys
progressions.description: IV, then a iii to augmented VI7 that falls into the ii, then a suspended V that resolves on beat three.

progressions.title: Fourth Floor Vamp
progressions.description: A Dorian i-IV vamp with a bVI to V7#9 turnaround in the last bar. Pulse the chords under a filtered drum loop.

progressions.title: Parallel Smoke
progressions.description: Fm11 planes down by half steps to Ebm11 and lands on Dbmaj9, then the Neapolitan Gbmaj7#11 into C7#9.

progressions.title: Ninth Street Glide
progressions.description: i-bVI then a ii-V to the relative major, with F7#9 as the V that resolves back to Bbm9.

progressions.title: Halfstep Honey
progressions.description: Gm11 rocks up a half step to Abmaj9 and back, then a ii-V to Bb, the bVI, and a minor ii-V home.

progressions.title: Room Tone
progressions.description: Dorian i to IV13 vamp, then bVI to an augmented V. Arpeggiated it floats; held it becomes a pad.

progressions.title: Drift Planes
progressions.description: Am11 planes up a step to Bm11 then lands on Cmaj9; a ii-V into Fmaj9 and E7#9 sends it back to the top.

progressions.title: Kitchen Radio
progressions.description: Parallel ninth chords climb step by step to the bVI, then A7#9 pulls back to Dm9. Built for a rolling bassline.

progressions.title: Lowlight Loop
progressions.description: Four bars of Dorian vamp, then iv-VII-III and the C#7#9 that drops back into F#m11.

progressions.title: Purple Carpet
progressions.description: i to a bright IV13, then bVI and the dominant with a moving top: #5 then #9.

progressions.title: Steam Pipe
progressions.description: Dorian i-IV, the bVI major nine (written as B), and Bb7#9 home. Slow and heavy with a long roll.

progressions.title: Sideways Ninths
progressions.description: Bm9 leans up to Cmaj9 and back, steps down to Am9 and Gmaj9, then F#7#9 resolves home.

progressions.title: Plum Wine
progressions.description: i to a Lydian bVI, then iv-VII-III and an augmented V. The #11 on the E chord is the color.

progressions.title: Pew Rest
progressions.description: The classic walk-up: every step from I to V gets a passing diminished between. Roll it slowly on an organ or piano.

progressions.title: Walkdown Mercy
progressions.description: A 7-3-6 walk-down from the IV: Dm7b5 to G7#9 into Cm9, then II7 to a 2-5-1. Ab over Bb and a ii-V to the IV round it off.

progressions.title: Altar Call
progressions.description: I to I7 over its third into the IV, a passing diminished up to I over the fifth, then VI7 to ii and IV over V.

progressions.title: Testimony
progressions.description: IV to a passing diminished, I over the fifth, VI7 to ii-V-I, and Ab13 to lead back to the IV.

progressions.title: Deacon Turnaround
progressions.description: A chromatic bass walk from G to D with diminished chords on every half step, closing on a quick I over five to V.

progressions.title: Hymnal Fog
progressions.description: I, then iii to VI7 into the ii, and a 7-3-6 run from the IV: G#m7b5, C#7#9, F#m9, then B13-Em9-A13sus home.

progressions.title: Organ Swell
progressions.description: IV, a passing diminished, I over the fifth, VI7 to ii-V-I, and Eb over F to set up the next pass.

progressions.title: Fellowship Hall
progressions.description: IV then the 7-3-6: D#m7b5, G#7#9, C#m9, then II7 to ii-V. Push it for a Sunday-morning lean.

progressions.title: Choir Robe
progressions.description: I-ii, a diminished passing up to I over the third, IV, another passing diminished, and Gb over Ab as the V.

progressions.title: Benediction
progressions.description: IV, a sharp-four diminished, I over five, vi, ii and a suspended V. Ends on D over E so the loop never fully closes.

progressions.title: Low Pew
progressions.description: Minor gospel: i, then iv-VII-III-VI round the circle, and a minor ii-V with F#7#9 back home.

progressions.title: Glory Hold
progressions.description: IV, a sharp-four diminished, I over the fifth, VI7 to ii-V-I, and B over C# as the turnaround.

progressions.title: Shout Break
progressions.description: Minor circle run: iv-VII-III-VI, a minor ii-V into Cm9, and C7#9 to throw it back to the iv. Pulse it hard.

progressions.title: Praise Break Run
progressions.description: i-iv-VII-III-VI, then the minor ii-V home. Stabs at 128 for a praise-break section.

progressions.title: Two Five Rush
progressions.description: Three 2-5-1s falling by whole steps: Bb, Ab, Gb. A minor ii-V into Cm9 brings it home.

progressions.title: Tambourine Walk
progressions.description: The bass walks Eb-F-G-Ab-A-Bb under I, ii, I over three, IV and a passing diminished; C7#9 to Fm11 and Ab over Bb close it.

progressions.title: Usher Steps
progressions.description: A walk-up from I to V with a passing diminished, VI7 to ii-V, then IV to borrowed iv, iii-VI7-ii and C over D.

progressions.title: Quick Hands Sunday
progressions.description: Diatonic climb to the IV, a 7-3-6 run, then one-beat VI7-ii-V chords that whip back to the top.

progressions.title: Organ Run Home
progressions.description: A fast 2-5-1, a 7-3-6, then IV and the sharp-four diminished to a one-beat run home: I over five, VI7, ii, V7b9.

progressions.title: Revival Kick
progressions.description: vi-ii-V-I, IV with a passing diminished to I over five, then A7#9 to throw it back to the vi.

progressions.title: Ashtray Blue
progressions.description: Dorian i to IV13, bVI and the #9 dominant. Four chords, all color; chop it or loop it as is.

progressions.title: Crate Dust
progressions.description: i to IV13, bVI, then the V moves from b9 to #5 in the last bar. Stab it over a dusty break.

progressions.title: Brass Lamp
progressions.description: ii-V, then iii to VI7 into the ii again; E13 is a half-step approach that slides up into Fm9.

progressions.title: Smoke Ring
progressions.description: Two ii-Vs a step apart, then Ebmaj9 and Ab13 (a bII7 colour) into the minor ii-V home. Eight slow bars.

progressions.title: Upright Alley
progressions.description: A descending line in the bass under Cm9: C, Bb, A, Ab, then G7#9. A walking line made for an upright sample.

progressions.title: Rhodes In The Rain
progressions.description: ii-V-I with the V moving to b9, then vi and E13, the tritone sub of the V-of-ii, back into Ebm9.

progressions.title: Cigarette Burn
progressions.description: Dorian i-IV, bVI, then D9#11 (a bII sub) into the altered V: #5, then #9.

progressions.title: Late Set
progressions.description: ii-V-I-VI7, ii and a suspended V, then iii-VI7-ii and A13, the tritone sub that falls into Abmaj9 on the way round.

progressions.title: Herringbone
progressions.description: Dorian i-IV13, bVI, and a minor ii-V. Sounds right chopped into stabs over a swung kick.

progressions.title: Velour Booth
progressions.description: A minor ii-V on each side of the tonic: half-diminished to #9, then bVI to an augmented V.

progressions.title: Midnight Library
progressions.description: I to the bIII13, a half step above the ii, then ii and a #9 V. That Db13 is the whole point.

progressions.title: Low Lit Lounge
progressions.description: ii-V, iii-VI7, then ii with Db9#11 as the tritone sub into Cmaj9, and A7#5 back to the ii.

progressions.title: Haze Bars
progressions.description: ii-V, iii to VI7 into the ii, then G9#11 a half step above that slides back down to F#m11.

progressions.title: Sax Room
progressions.description: I to the bIII13, ii-V, and Ab9#11 (tritone sub) falling into Gmaj9. Leaves space for a horn sample.

progressions.title: Wet Pavement
progressions.description: ii-V, then iii to VI7 back into the ii and a b9 V. A circle that never sits on the I.

progressions.title: Basement Quartet
progressions.description: ii-V, iii-VI7, Bmaj9, then D9#11, the tritone sub of G#7, that resolves down into C#m9.
